definition.title: Quotes + Day log smoke test ({{run}})
definition.body_md: Phil's live check of Quotes v1 (0126) and Day log Part A (0127/0128), shipped 2026-09-18. The API paths were smoke-tested from the PC (Quotes 26/26, Day log 15/19 then 5/5 after the persona fix); this ticket is the human half — the phone, the bot, the pages. Tick as you go; type what you saw in the answer boxes; anything that fails stays unticked with a comment naming the step id.

values.label: A friend who exists in People

intro.verdict_html: Four phases, about 25 minutes plus one evening. Phases 1–2 are Quotes (the page, then a voice capture through the review queue). Phase 3 is the Day log on Telegram — it wants a real evening, so do it tonight at the prompt. Phase 4 is the Day log in the app and can be done any time.
prerequisites: Signed in on the phone and the PC
A person in People whose first name you can say (the value {{friend}})
Settings → Journal: the nightly prompt is ON by default at 21:30 London — leave it on for phase 3

steps.title: Open Organisation → Quotes (nav or the org-index card); the page loads with the search box, All / Mine chips, Merch, and the view switch
+ ADD → type a line you said yourself, Said by = Me, SAVE — a card appears at the top with a research badge (researching, then original / known / skipped)

fields.label: What the badge said after a few seconds

steps.title: + ADD the same line with two words changed — a near-duplicate warning names the existing quote with a percentage; CANCEL
Tap the quote text → the detail sheet: change Context, SAVE; the card shows the context line
In the sheet press RE-RUN — the research panel fills (verdict, confidence, sources if any); press WRONG — badge goes to wrong; THEIR OWN — badge goes to original
Tap the merch button on the card — it ticks in place; toggle the Merch chip — only ticked quotes remain; EXPORT downloads quotes-<date>.csv with headers Quote, Said by, Own…
Switch the view to By month, then By person — headers group correctly; Mine shows only your own

phases.title: Quotes — voice capture through review
phases.lede_html: The bot never creates the quote directly: it reads back, you approve.

steps.title: Send the bot a voice note: "Quote from {{friend}}: never trust a skinny chef" — the reply starts Saved for review — {{friend}}: "…" (with (speaker uncertain) only if it could not tell who said it)

fields.label: The read-back, verbatim
fields.placeholder: Saved for review — Jake: "Never trust a skinny chef"

steps.title: Open Captures → Review: the capture shows Kind = quote with the quote editor — text, Said by (your friend pre-selected, or the picker with "(matches)" hints), When, Context, Source
Approve — the card leaves the queue; Quotes now lists it with the friend's chip; the friend's People page shows it in the Quotes block; the People list row says "1 quote"
Send a second voice note with almost the same line — on the review card the near-duplicate warning offers keep existing / replace its text; choose keep existing and approve — no second quote appears

phases.title: Day log — one evening on Telegram
phases.lede_html: Do this tonight. The bot asks at 21:30 London (Settings → Journal to change it). Every reply you send while the day is open goes to the interview; start a message with /c to capture something instead.

steps.title: At the prompt time the bot sends "Evening. How was the day? Talk, Quick or Skip?" with four buttons; the Journal card on the dashboard says PROMPTED
Press Snooze — "Snoozed — I'll ask again at …"; the prompt comes back after the snooze (default 60 min; set it to 5 in Settings → Journal first if you don't want to wait)
Press Talk — "Go on then — where did the day take you?"; answer with a voice note mentioning a place and a person; you get one question back (a "who's X?" if the name is new)
Answer two or three more; check it never states a fact you didn't say and never asks two questions at once; then send "done" — a one-line recap and "mood / energy / sleep / productivity, 1–5?"
Reply "4 3" only — it asks for the missing two; reply "5 2" — the recap line plus a link to /journal/<date>
Open the link: the entry reads as what you said (no invented adjectives), scene bullets underneath, the four scores set, the transcript below with a cost line in pence

phases.title: Day log — the app
phases.lede_html: Any time. Uses a past date so tonight is untouched.

steps.title: Journal (nav) — the day list with month groups, status chips and the score strip at the top; the legacy entries (if any) show "migrated from the old journal" when opened
Pick a date last week in the date box → OPEN; press SKIP — SCORES ONLY; type "3 3 4 4" and SEND — status becomes skipped, cost stays 0
Open another past date → TALK → type two lines about it, then "done", then the scores — status closed, an entry appears; EDIT the entry, change a word, SAVE — it sticks after reload
Tap a score number on a closed day — it changes in place; tap it again — it clears

Send the bot a reflective line while NO day is open (e.g. "feeling calm tonight, good walk by the river") — reply "📓 Added to today's day log"; today's day page shows it in the transcript tagged capture; Captures lists it routed to Day log
Settings → Journal: change the prompt time, save (blur), reload — it persists; turn Nightly prompt off if you don't want it yet
